card.name: Rounding doses to nearest amount
card.fires_on: The word "rounded" or "rounding" (or a word just before where it would come) in dose calculation instructions, right before "to the nearest" a unit, such as 1 mg or 0.1 mL.

modes.label: Rounded after a calculation
modes.description: The word rounded or rounding follows a computed dose or volume, before "to the nearest".
modes.example: restart CRYSVITA at 0.5 mg/kg of body weight,<< rounded>> to the nearest 1 mg, administered

modes.label: Words leading into rounding
modes.description: A word in a dosing sentence where a rounding phrase is expected to come next.
modes.example: Dosage of PROCYSBI by Body Weight in Cysteamine-Naïve Patients 1 Year of Age and Older (Dosage Rounded<< Using>> Available Strengths of Capsules or Pack

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word round or rounded next.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing instructions where the dose gets rounded to the nearest amount.
